# kard-evolve

> Creatures that evolve, measurably: readers of damaged FallKard seal codes, bred, battled and selected against 192 real vision-model misreads, graded by rules on held-out cards, sealed before the first generation, and re-runnable to the byte.

## The result

<!-- ⟦RESULTS-BEGIN⟧ generated by tools/make-page.mjs — do not edit here -->
**Sealed, not yet run.** The rules, the configuration and the sha256 of the world and the kernel were committed before the first generation: on the held-out cards (real and damaged reads), the champion's fitness is higher than generation 0's best; the champion carries the fold U → V — found by mutation and selection, never told; the champion names no wrong card on the held-out reads; on the 96 held-out REAL model replies alone, the champion resolves more cards than the spec's own reader, and none wrong; re-running the evolution from this seal gives a byte-identical record — CI re-runs it on every push. The result lands here whichever way it goes.
<!-- ⟦RESULTS-END⟧ -->
